ideas.pitch: An AI-powered automated PCB schematic and analog circuit troubleshooting assistant for ECE students.
ideas.problem_statement: Strengthen fundamentals of electronic circuits and devices, and evaluate knowledge of Analog and Digital Electronics.
ideas.title: CircuitGuard-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core ECE curriculum focus of MNNIT Allahabad's mentorship program, appealing to judges looking for educational utility in core electronics.

ideas.pitch: A web-based interactive signals and systems visualizer for real-time Fourier transforms and convolution mapping.
ideas.problem_statement: Assess understanding of Signals and Systems.
ideas.title: SignalScope-JS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an immediate, working browser-based interactive demo that makes abstract mathematical concepts visually obvious to engineering evaluators.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser-based communication systems simulator demonstrating ASK, FSK, and PSK modulation schemes with noise injection.
ideas.problem_statement: Test concepts related to Communication Systems.
ideas.title: ModemSim-Core
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses communication engineering fundamentals with a working simulation that allows real-time parameter tweaking during evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A digital electronics truth table generator, Karnaugh map simplifier, and combinational logic verifier tool.
ideas.problem_statement: Evaluate knowledge of Analog and Digital Electronics.
ideas.title: LogicVerify-CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday pain point for engineering students verifying lab assignments quickly and accurately.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino-based data acquisition dashboard for measuring real-world RC circuit transient responses and graphing time constants.
ideas.problem_statement: Strengthen fundamentals of electronic circuits and devices.
ideas.title: SensorLink-Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages physical hardware integration, which consistently stands out and scores well in engineering assessments over purely software-only submissions.
